question: In a certain code language, PRINCE is written as OQHODF. How will BUDGET be written in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] Logic : • **In first three letters of the word - (1)** • **In last three letter of the word + (1)**
